facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Life in Adtech: How models and algorithms help drive advertising performance' was published on February 24, 2022.
StackAdapt's platform features include page context AI campaigns and automatic optimization of bid prices, which are supported by machine learning processes run by its Data Science team.
facts.quote: Data science includes all the invisible (but indispensable!) machine learning processes that are behind the various features that we offer on the StackAdapt platform, such as page context AI campaigns and automatic optimization of bid prices.
